items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1958-07-18
items.q: He studied with this fellow, Kel, from England, a classical player.

ctx.x: I think Benny Goodwin is playing a double ember show. Maybe he does. I think so. I can tell the way he put that clapping in his mouth.
He studied with this fellow, Kel, from England, a classical player.
